rawContent: @xintra @kwetoday My book is out October 11! It touches on this but it's not about this -- it's about safety cuing for greater resilience during crisis, with a focus on #metoo situations (both when you're responding to someone who was harmed or someone who did harm).

@lauragoode I wrote a book about what to do when #metoo happens in one's circle of friends: Disrupting the Bystander: When #metoo Happens Among Friends (Thorntree Fundamentals) https://t.co/yHBs1EdcrA 

Out in October, but if it seems useful, I'll shoot you a digital advance copy right away!
